description: This file contains unit tests for encoding 'Any' type values using the 'AnyCodable' wrapper in Swift. It verifies correct encoding of arrays, dictionaries, and primitive types, and their conversion to JSON objects.

methods.name: encodes swift array and dictionary values
methods.description: Tests encoding of Swift array and dictionary values into JSON data and verifies their content.

methods.name: protocol any codable encodes primitive arrays
methods.description: Tests encoding of arrays containing primitive types and NSNull into JSON data and verifies the resulting JSON structure.
